construction_contract.closest_tie_rule: smallest member of [0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2]; observed tie counts are per target
construction_contract.hash_contract: SHA-256 of ordered instructions, qubits, parameters, and global phase; RZ parameters and global phase are normalized modulo 2*pi
construction_contract.non_clifford_definition: RZ angle farther than 1e-8 radians from a multiple of pi/2 modulo 2*pi
construction_contract.selection: uniform retained-position subset of exact size r

measurement_contract.exact_noise: Aer density-matrix expectation with gate noise, multiplied by the exact independent symmetric-readout factor (1 - 2*p_ro)^locality
measurement_contract.finite_shot: seeded binomial marginal draw from each exact noisy Pauli expectation

target_panel.description: One seeded target for every shipped TFI width/step pair, QAOA width/p/graph-class tuple, and Heisenberg width/step pair selected by --families.
